rule.start: the first daily row of research/jlp_forward.jsonl; earlier jlp-info files are a sanity check, not rows
rule.hold: JLP tokens = jlp_usd / JLP price (aumUsd / supply) at the first row, held unchanged to the end
rule.hedge: at each daily row t: short, per asset, the net delta per JLP (owned - locked + shortSizes / shortAvg, over the JLP supply) x JLP held, traded at the row's mark; it earns from t to t+1 (no look-ahead)
rule.venue: Binance USDT-M perps: premiumIndex marks; fundingRate settlements x the mark each one carries
rule.second_venue: Hyperliquid: markPx; hourly fundingHistory x oracle price interpolated between rows
rule.capital: JLP value + margin x gross short notional, at each row (margin held idle)
rule.one_off_costs: JLP round trip x jlp_usd, plus taker x gross short at the last row (closing the hedge); charged once and amortised evenly over max(days elapsed, one_off_days) for the verdict; the same over max(days elapsed, min_days), and the excess before one-offs, are reported beside it
rule.savings: sUSDS.ssr() read at each row (an APY), accrued simple over the period as house_vaults does
rule.kill: at 60 days, annualised excess over the savings rate on capital below +1% a year
kill_now: the rolling 14-day standard deviation of the daily hedged return on capital above 0.5% on 15 consecutive days (a persistently ineffective hedge: one tail day sits in at most 14 windows, so it cannot reach the kill alone); a single window above 0.5% is a warning
the trailing 30-day fee yield (DefiLlama supply-side revenue / JLP AUM) below 6.5%
rule.review: flagged for a reader, as the book's exploit / fee-split / AUM-limit / depeg gate: the AUM limit or the custody set differs from the first row, a non-stable custody is left unhedged, or the JLP DEX price is more than 1% from NAV
rule.promote: at 60 days, excess above +2.5% a year with Newey-West t above 2
rule.comparison: the backtest's chosen hedge (house_vaults roll60: 60-day trailing OLS of daily JLP returns on SOL/ETH/BTC, refit every 7 days, >= 20 observations) on the same rows and costs, its window fed by house_vaults' DefiLlama/Binance history, a bridge to the first row, then the ledger's own periods

changes.what: the verdict's excess amortises the one-off costs (JLP round trip + hedge close) over 365 days, was the 60-day test; the 60-day amortisation and the before-one-offs excess stay as reported columns
changes.why: 365 days is the intended minimum hold; amortised over 60 days the one-offs put ~1.2pp a year of drag on a +1% kill line

changes.what: the sigma kill fires only when the rolling 14-day sigma has been above 0.5% on 15 consecutive days, was the first window above 0.5%; a single window above 0.5% is a warning
changes.why: the gate is for a persistently ineffective hedge, and one tail day (the backtest's worst was -2.06%) lifts a 14-day sigma above 0.5% on its own
changes.caveat: found in testing: one tail day sits in exactly 14 consecutive 14-day windows, so a 14-day run could still be reached by that day alone; the coordinator set the run to 15 (longer than the window) on 2026-10-11, before any scored period

revisions.reason: both decided by the coordinator on 2026-10-11, before any outcome (one row, no scored period)
